title: The Witches Mountain
writer: Raúl Artigot, Juan Cortés, Félix Fernández
actors: Patty Shepard, Cihangir Gaffari, Mónica Randall
plot: A photojournalist traveling through the Pyrenees on assignment with a beautiful writer stays overnight at an ancient Spanish castle and hears that the adjoining mountain is occupied by a coven of witches.
